summary: Final Web scientific review found no genuine discrepancy requiring correction, so MANUSCRIPT_FINAL_R8_2026-08-22.md, MANUSCRIPT_R8_SCIENTIFIC_QC_2026-08-22.md, and MANUSCRIPT_R8_FIGURE_TABLE_PLAN_2026-08-22.md were intentionally left unchanged. The package matches the committed R8 production/offline evidence for the 96-config/48-pair/1440-row factor space; 25 exact, 19 lower-bound, 3 upper-bound, and 1 indeterminate DOF50 effects; 9 peak-window-censored pairs; recorded mean delta DOF50 of 0.16693986012763976 D with 42 positive and 6 negative recorded effects; 48/48 negative delta MTFa at 0 D and 48/48 negative through-focus mean delta MTFa; all 12 coupling-cell censoring/bound semantics; production CSV provenance hashes; R5.2/R6/R7 direct Binary4 copy-on-write provenance; 96 entity-before and 96 entity-after snapshots; and the committed 72-figure traceability set (48 raw plus 24 summary).
limitations: OpticStudio was not run, and no production evidence, offline evidence, source code, accepted Task015 evidence, runtime diagnostics, default branch, or preceding branch was modified.

This review establishes scientific and traceability consistency of the manuscript package against the committed R8 evidence; it is not clinical validation, does not add patient-level evidence, and does not authorize commercial-IOL ranking or patient-level selection claims.

The immutable production evidence continues to record manual_web_review_required=true and automatic_progression_allowed=false, while the offline evidence continues to record formal_scientific_lock=false. This task records completion and PASS of the requested final Web manuscript review without rewriting those evidence fields or authorizing automatic progression or merge.

The external background literature cited in the manuscript was not independently re-verified in this bounded review; the review was restricted to the declared committed manuscript and R8 evidence sources.
